title: Verify model capabilities with a bounded development-only pilot
description:
## Scope

Use a small fixed development fixture to check Jev, Kev, and Laya loading, label parsing, context serialization, maximum useful context, latency, and probability availability. Record versions/hardware and separate installation/download/model-call steps. Freeze a small preflight and ceiling before explicitly approved live calls; never involve scoreboard rows.

## Definition of done

A compatibility report records successful zero-shot/few-shot paths or precise exclusions, observed context limits, and real usage; adapter defects are linked back to core issues.

## Companion-project coordination

- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-d556540e-71b5-55cc-9323-143d674bba3d`.
- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-f64b3f0f-7440-53d9-81a8-d7e322c35a34`.
- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-a56306ec-1922-5343-ba9f-f3ee47f4742a`.

These are cross-repository references; local Kanbus blocked-by relationships encode prerequisites within this repository.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Native Jev development-only pilot implemented with Terra subagents, without DSPy or live calls. Actual pinned-cache plans enumerate 21 logical and 21 distinct physical requests per dataset (42 total): zero-shot plus the maximum local-estimate request for each of four sizes and five seeds, canonical ordering. Frozen text-free plans and pilot preregistration are being verified. Paid collection remains unapproved. No accuracy finding, no scoreboard source rows, no retries/recovery, no full-study approval. Compatibility report and Kev/Laya follow-up remain incomplete, so this issue stays in progress.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Verification complete for pilot infrastructure: 232 specs pass locally and 232 pass from a source archive in an isolated minimal environment without datasets, pyarrow, typesafe, dataset caches, or Git history. Read-only Terra review found preregistration-before-ledger and output-overwrite defects; failing specs were written first and both are fixed. Wrapper and collection enforce the exact unique-request ceiling, historical retries reject, resume does not construct a second provider, and compatibility reports exclude benchmark metrics. Pilot plans/preregistration remain unapproved; human approval requested for at most 42 paid attempts total, without authorizing the full study.

comments.author: home
comments.text: HANDOFF: Published pilot infrastructure is commit 974aad38acbab3c22b8fc7fffb4b9f255a7adb69; GitHub test/release run 36787427555 succeeded and released v0.7.0. Committed studies/INITIAL_JEV_PILOT.md plus studies/pilots/ag_news.plan.json and emotion.plan.json freeze 21 physical requests each, total 42, no retries; development only. Human approval was requested but NOT received. Latest human instruction is STOP and hand off, not permission to collect. No live pilot/study calls or compatibility results were generated. Leave this task incomplete. If resumed by a new agent, obtain explicit approval before any of those 42 paid attempts; full development/scoreboard/order/model studies each need separate exact preflight and approval. Initial development proposed ceilings are NOT approval. Do not treat .env availability or delegated statistical choices as spend authority.
